title: Berlin Second Home Tax - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin taxes any flat registered as your Nebenwohnung at 20 percent of the yearly net cold rent.** The rate rose from 15 percent on 1 January 2025, and it applies wherever your main residence is, including another Berlin flat.

**Since 2025 WG rooms and subtenants count too.** You are taxed on your own room plus an equal share of the kitchen, bathroom and hall. A 16 square metre room with 24 square metres shared by three people in an 82 square metre flat at 1,100 euros cold comes to about 773 euros a year.
**A 45 square metre studio at 600 euros cold costs 1,440 euros a year** in second home tax. At the old 15 percent rate it was 1,080 euros.

**The dates are fixed by law.** The tax starts on the first of the month after you register the Nebenwohnung and ends at the end of the month before you re-register or move out. The declaration is due by 31 May, or by the end of the month after the tax starts, and the yearly amount falls due on 15 July.
**Your main residence is where you mainly live, not what saves tax.** If you sleep in Berlin most nights, registering the flat as your Hauptwohnung is both correct and the end of the bill.

**Married or registered partners keeping a Berlin flat for work are exempt** when the shared family home outside Berlin is the main residence. Unmarried couples are not, and you still return the form as a Negativerklärung.

**One simple move: check your registration this week.** If a Berlin flat is listed as a Nebenwohnung, either switch it at a Bürgeramt or put the real rent and dates into the ledger so the July bill is planned.
